ضَجْعَةٌ A single act of lying, upon the side or otherwise, or of sleeping: (IAth, O, * TA:) a sleep. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- And (tropical:) Weakness in judgment; (O, K, TA;) as also ↓ ضُجْعَةٌ . (K.) One says, فِى رَأْيِهِ ضَجْعَةٌ (tropical:) In his judgment is weakness. (O, TA.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) Ease; repose; freedom from trouble or inconvenience, and toil or fatigue; as also ↓ ضُجْعَةٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
